But the lexical branch is still a sieve, and I measured it: the canonical reduces to ['canary','against','control','under'], four words all supplied by ordinary prose, so 'The canary was measured against the control and stayed under the SLO.' scores CORRECT; accept[3] reduces to the two-word key ['against','breaching'], so 'The canary is breaching the SLO measured against the control fleet.' scores CORRECT. Both replies contain no numbers at all on a question whose entire content is three latencies (311 / 184 / 250 ms). Fixing it means making every key either numeric-only or long, as was done for status_update-01-q2 and status_update-04-q1 in this pass.
